title: In Leaked Audio, Flock CEO Tells Cops Backlash to the Company Isn’t Real
summary: 404 Media reports on leaked audio from a private police conference where Flock CEO Garrett Langley dismissed anti-Flock protests as fake, claiming without evidence that social media opposition is driven by Russian bots. Langley also said he prefers not to do press interviews and would not apologize for the company's ALPR technology.

key_quotes.quote: Garrett Langley, the CEO of automatic license plate reader company Flock, told an audience of police chiefs at a private police conference Sunday that anti-Flock protests around the country are not real
Social media chatter on Flock is down about 95 percent from July. It went down 50 percent last week when Ukraine bombed a Russian data center with a drone.
